fusions.name: Clinging Sip
fusions.desc: Throws an arm over the first enemy it meets and bites, dealing 4 damage and healing you for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Shriek in the Murk
fusions.desc: Vents a cloud of ink and shrieks through it, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, stunning each for 1 second and leaving it [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cloak Turned Inside Out
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Dusk Skin
fusions.desc: At night your dodge chance rises by 12%.
